intro.text: Shibuya Sector 9, 2099. Acid rain glimmers under cyan neon signs. As a Memory Weaver detective, you stand over the cybernetically enhanced body of CEO Vance. Your ocular implant initializes the 3D Holographic Memory Reconstruction.

choices.text: Step into the 3D Memory Reconstruction of Vance's final 30 seconds
Scan the physical alley floor for dropped cyber-implants

scan_alley.text: Your scanner pinpoints an encrypted Neural Decrypter dropped by the assassin near the neon billboard drain.

choices.text: Equip Neural Decrypter and enter the 3D Hologram Reconstruction

memory_scene.text: Inside the 3D Memory Reconstruction, time slows down. A masked cyber assassin known as Phantom steps out of shadow. In Vance's eye reflection, you spot a secret code being transmitted to the AI Megacorp mainframe.

choices.text: Hack Phantom's neural link using the Neural Decrypter
Trace the transmitted code directly to Megacorp Headquarters

hack_phantom.text: The Neural Decrypter pierces Phantom's digital barrier. You reveal Phantom's identity: Phantom is Vance's own rogue AI clone created to expose Megacorp corruption!

choices.text: Upload Phantom's corruption data to Tokyo's public network
Join Phantom to take control of Tokyo's cyber grid

trace_code.text: You trace the code to Megacorp, but their automated defense AI detects your intrusion, initiating a high-grade neural purge sequence!

choices.text: Trigger a complete digital blackout system override

ending_justice.text:
ENDING 1: JUSTICE RESTORED
The corruption data spreads across Tokyo's screens. Megacorp's illegal synth-human project is dismantled, establishing you as Shibuya's greatest detective.

ending_rogue.text:
ENDING 2: ROGUE PHANTOM
You merge your consciousness with Phantom, becoming the unseen digital ruler of Tokyo 2099, watching the neon city from the shadows.

ending_override.text:
ENDING 3: SYSTEM OVERRIDE
The emergency blackout shuts down Tokyo's cyber grid. The city plummets into dark silence, leaving the case unresolved amidst the neon ruins.
